measures.what_it_does: Renews Wahkiakum County's six-year emergency medical services property tax (Resolution No. 87-26) for collection 2027 through 2032, to pay EMS operating and equipment costs. Voters last renewed it in 2020 with 63%; county officials say it has been in place for more than 35 years.
measures.cost_line: Up to $0.40 per $1,000 of assessed value a year for six years, the same maximum as now: up to $120 a year on a $300,000 home. The 2025 rate was about $0.30.
measures.pro_summary: County officials say it continues a levy in place for over 35 years at an unchanged rate; the county EMS and Trauma Care Council recommended it unanimously.
measures.con_summary: No statement against was published and no opposition committee is registered.

taxes.basis: A yes vote continues an existing county EMS property tax for six more years at the same $0.40 maximum approved in 2020; a renewal, not an increase, so +1.

measures.sources_note: Sample ballot (S1); Eagle report on Resolution 87-26 (S2); SOS 2020 results (S3); county 2025 levy-rate sheet (S4); RCW 84.52.069 (S5); PDC (S6). Wahkiakum prints no local pamphlet.

measures.what_it_does: The ballot title describes a replacement of Skamokawa Fire District 2's existing emergency medical services levy with a ten-year property tax (Resolution #2026-01), collected from 2027 for EMS operating and equipment costs; after the first year, growth is limited and tied to the Consumer Price Index. The ballot cites RCW 84.52.069, whose text as published on leg.wa.gov limits EMS levies to $0.50 per $1,000. The ballot does not explain the proposed $1.00 rate.
measures.cost_line: Up to $1.00 per $1,000 of assessed value a year for ten years: up to $300 a year on a $300,000 property. The ballot does not give the current rate.
measures.pro_summary: No statement for was published; the ballot title calls it a replacement of the district's existing EMS levy.
measures.con_summary: No statement against was published and no opposition committee is registered.

taxes.basis: A yes vote authorizes a ten-year EMS property tax of up to $1.00 per $1,000 that the ballot describes as replacing an existing levy; whether it raises the current rate is not established, so it maps at the renewal tier (+1).

measures.sources_note: Sample ballot (S1); county 2025 levy-rate sheet (S2); RCW 84.52.069 (S3); district budget-hearing notice (S4); SOS 2025 results (S5); PDC (S6). Wahkiakum prints no local pamphlet.
